purpose: Freeze the real Ptichi Data Authority treatment/control assignment and a stable English Search query panel before any post-deployment outcome review.
siteSpecificRationale: The generic Goose plan proposed 20-50 treatment pages, but Ptichi has a binding search-expansion gate, only 18 comparable published entities in the current pilot universe and a stale production deployment. The owner-controlled PTI-DA-001 design therefore uses 12 existing treatment entities and 6 unchanged controls, adds no indexable URLs and is the authoritative site-specific cohort. The former acquisition branch is no longer a live branch; its planning commit is an ancestor of current main, so this freeze binds to the current main implementation ref instead.

sourceEvidence.notes: PTI-DA-001 is the source of truth for treatment/control assignment. Current main contains the acquisition work, but owner-side measurement must not start until a production receipt proves the implementation ref is live.

give a concise project status update

assignmentPolicy: Treatment/control membership is imported from the reviewed PTI-DA-001 artifact and is frozen before post-deployment outcomes. Controls must not receive intentional Data Authority treatment during the first observation window; correctness, safety and broken-link fixes are allowed only when recorded as contamination.

queryPanel.selectionBasis: Queries are a fixed observational panel derived from the existing Ptichi acquisition wedge, PTI-DA-001 primary jobs and the 2026-09-09 public-result review. They are not search-volume claims and are not rewritten later to fit observed winners.

decisionRules.GO: At least three treatment entities receive relevant non-brand impressions from distinct query families and the movement is not explained equally by controls, while no page-quality, crawl or release-truth guardrail regresses.
decisionRules.CHANGE: Treatment pages gain impressions but query-to-page fit is poor, or useful continuation is weak; revise page value, answer shape or relationships instead of adding more URLs.
decisionRules.HOLD: Treatment is not verifiably deployed, owner-side measurement is unavailable, the window is immature, or safety/release truth blocks interpretation.
decisionRules.DROP: Treatment requires thin or duplicate pages, fabricated evidence, misleading structured data/freshness, or repeatedly creates crawl/index noise without useful discovery.
